about: A partial-overlap recall set for lamp-memory's kept list (#2510): each question rephrases one kept thing of its language the way people do, sharing some of its words, and each target has a distractor that shares words with the question but is the wrong thing (16 targets and 16 distractors each). Which of a pair is newer alternates, so a tie broken by the newest favours neither. A kept thing's id is its order: a higher id is newer. Made-up content, no real people. Vietnamese is accented, in NFC. Never send it to any API.
